messages:
maria: quick heads up — local sample-app build is fine in node, but when bundled for edge with Vite the runtime throws. steps to repro below.

maria: repro steps (minimal):
1) git clone git@github.com:redwood-inference/sample-app-sdk.git --branch edge-bundler-repro
2) npm ci && npm run build:edge
3) run the edge sim: EDGE=1 npm start (we use fast-edge-sim)

maria: observed error on edge-sim: "TypeError: createClient is not a function" from src/server/api.ts where we have:

  import Redwood from 'redwood-inference';
  const client = Redwood.createClient({ apiKey: process.env.RW_KEY });

maria: hypothesis: published package has both ESM and CJS entrypoints with conditional exports. Vite/esbuild flattens the export into a default-only shape and the edge loader treats the namespace as { default: { createClient } } so r.createClient is undefined.

devon: can you paste the built bundle snippet where createClient is invoked?

maria: snippet from dist/edge/index.js after vite build:

  var r = n('redwood-inference');
  var client = r.createClient({apiKey:process.env.RW_KEY});

maria: but r is actually { default: { createClient: [Function] } } so r.createClient -> undefined. Node's CJS coercion masks this in normal node runs, but the edge runtime doesn't.

olivia: we've seen rollup/commonjs plugin produce both shapes depending on config. sometimes it rewrites to __toCommonJS and callers assume top-level.

kevin: have you tried `import * as Redwood from 'redwood-inference'` ? that generally preserves namespace for rollup/vite.

maria: tried it — vite still emitted a default-only shape. toggling package.json type to module changes outcomes.

devon: two fixes: 1) change SDK build to include a cjs interop shim that sets module.exports.createClient = exports.createClient; 2) update sample app docs to prefer `import { createClient } from 'redwood-inference'` which avoids default/namespace pitfalls.

maria: also hitting a TS typing mismatch: users see "Namespace 'redwood-inference' has no exported member 'createClient'" depending on moduleResolution and whether types point at dist/types/index.d.ts. bundlers can pick wrong d.ts because of conditional exports mapping.

olivia: can you add a tiny repro script in the sample-app repo so devex can run a single command to reproduce? we should include vite build + edge-sim in CI.

maria: I'll add `npm run repro:edge` that runs build + edge-sim and prints the stack. gist for now: https://gist.github.com/maria/edge-repro-snippet

ci-bot: note — CI build #482 failed on branch edge-bundler-repro with same runtime error. logs: https://ci.internal/build/482

kevin: CI action item: add test matrix entry (vite|rollup|webpack) x (node|edge-sim) x (tsc check) to catch shape and typing regressions early.

devon: sdk-build change: produce dist/interop.cjs that guarantees top-level named exports and add an esbuild/vite shape check test that asserts typeof require('redwood-inference').createClient === 'function' after bundling.

maria: also an auth/retry gotcha — some edge fetch polyfills strip Authorization headers for 302/redirects or internal polyfilled fetch paths. if createClient relies on fetch-based token refresh, retries can silently fail. add KEEP_AUTH_HEADER=true to edge-sim to reproduce.

olivia: good catch. doc the recommended import pattern and the env flag in sample-app README. plus add a minimal TS types smoke test that resolves exported members.

maria: I'll open a small sample-app PR with the repro script and a workaround note, and a follow-up SDK PR for the interop shim. will update this thread with PR links. thanks all :thumbsup:
